subject: R/qtl-MQM and model fit after scantwo

messages.author: 91775d3eda18ae33
messages.subject: R/qtl-MQM and model fit after scantwo
parts:
Hi professor,

I am novice in r/qtl, and confused by Multiple qtr mapping. What is the main difference between mapping through R/qtl-MQM which is documented in a seperate section and model fit after scantwo? Do i need to try both and compare them then select a better one for multiple qtr mapping?

And for R/qtl-MQM, in sim.cross function there is no option for dh population in type argument, is there any way able to fix this?

Thanks,
Amber

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] R/qtl-MQM and model fit after scantwo
parts:
R/qtl-MQM is similar to composite interval mapping, but uses a different
method for handling missing genotype information. I'm not sure what you
mean by "model fit after scanone", but no you don't _need_ to try both
methods.

sim.cross() can simulate a backcross, which is operationally equivalent
to doubled haploids.

karl
